notes.text:
This update for python-aiohttp fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2025-53643: request smuggling vulnerability due to incorrect parsing trailer sections of an HTTP request
  (bsc#1246517).

notes.text: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to version 3.12.14, the Python parser is vulnerable to a request smuggling vulnerability due to not parsing trailer sections of an HTTP request. If a pure Python version of aiohttp is installed (i.e. without the usual C extensions) or AIOHTTP_NO_EXTENSIONS is enabled, then an attacker may be able to execute a request smuggling attack to bypass certain firewalls or proxy protections. Version 3.12.14 contains a patch for this issue.
